The numbers are: 16 - dieciséis, 17 - diecisiete, 18 - dieciocho, 19 - diecinueve. For larger numbers, the building blocks are 20 - veinte, 30 - treinta, 40 - cuarenta, 50 - cincuenta, 60 - sesenta, 70 - setenta, 80 - ochenta, 90 - noventa. With this knowledge, you can count or write up to 99 in Spanish. It is important to practice regularly to retain and recognize the numbers confidently.
